evidence: STATIC: task/tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical in content to the frozen template tests/Dockerfile (all 46 lines; diff -r of tests/ shows only app_context.md, prompts and judge.toml differ; Dockerfile, test.sh, tools/, .dockerignore identical), so it is template-controlled. It ships: base images by tag (line 1 'FROM node:22-bookworm-slim AS node-runtime', line 2 'FROM python:3.12-slim', line 4 COPY /usr/local) giving node 22 + python3; judge CLI pinned (line 17 '@anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281', plus codex@0.151.0); Playwright pinned via line 19 '@playwright/mcp@0.0.79' which provides the playwright-mcp binary every judge.toml invokes ('command = "playwright-mcp"', args '--executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium'); browser installed by that pinned package's own playwright cli (lines 33-38 'node "$PW_CLI" install --with-deps chromium' and symlink to /usr/local/bin/chromium), so the browser revision is fixed by the pinned MCP version; rewardkit pinned (line 31 'harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7') with an assert-guarded patch (line 41) that fails the build loudly rather than silently if the string is absent; app runtime deps pinned (lines 20-21 'express@5.1.0', 'better-sqlite3@12.4.1') matching the agent image environment/Dockerfile lines 10-11 and solution package.json lines 14-15 exactly; util-linux (setpriv) and procps (line 13) needed by test.sh lines 99-111; python3 at /usr/local/bin/python3 for restart_mcp.py (functional judge.toml 'command = "/usr/local/bin/python3"'). NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules (line 9) matches test.sh line 106 and integration.md lines 3-4 ('Express and better-sqlite3 already available through NODE_PATH; use only those packages and Node built-ins'), so a conforming submission cannot need a package the verifier lacks. Agent and verifier both use node:22 tag, so a submission that vendors native better-sqlite3 in /app/node_modules gets the same Node 22 ABI. (b) conforming app that could fail because of the image — a brief-conforming app uses only express/better-sqlite3/Node built-ins, all present at identical versions; none found.
